links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified online spasmodic dysphonia patient education materials (38 PEMs)
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog, SMOG) and content fidelity of the revised text
links.effect: Original PEMs required about 10th grade to early college reading levels. ChatGPT-4o mini improved readability on all four indices (P <0.001; large effect sizes). Of 407 statement pairs, 57% of changes were dropped content, 29% were specificity reduction, and 5% were added content. Overall, 21% of PEMs were fully preserved, 50% partially preserved, and 29% not preserved.
links.tradeoff: Information loss: omitted clinical detail and reduced specificity, with 29% of PEMs not preserved. Expert oversight is needed to ensure accuracy and completeness.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o mini substantially improves the readability of SD-related PEMs but often at the cost of reduced clinical specificity or loss of essential information.

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompt (sixth-grade) with content fidelity check
